files.purpose: five adult hero sprites in evenly sliced 128x192 cells
grunt, fast and tank enemy sprites in 128x128 cells
rivalry, stun and breach HUD icons in 64x64 cells
portrait HUD mock showing active rivalry gameplay

style: Polished original vertical-comic characters with plum ink, cream highlights and jewel-tone tailoring. The salon-street HUD uses rose velvet, restrained gold trim and high-contrast live text.
integration: Slice sprites/heroes.png into five 128x192 cells, enemies.png into three 128x128 cells, and icons.png into three 64x64 cells.
Use live text for score and xN chain; place the three breach-heart icons inside the top safe area as shown in ui/hud-mock.png.
Place each hero in a touch slot at least 44 px wide and map slots 1-2 to left, 3 to centre, and 4-5 to right.

For idle hide pair effects; for rivalry show the first icon with a rose-gold glow; for stun show the second icon and mute both heroes; for game over add an opaque cream-and-plum results panel above the dimmed battlefield.
